reasons: The opinion frames the case as whether to extend the Wade-Gilbert exclusionary rule to identification testimony from a police-station showup before indictment or formal charge.

The opinion declines to impose that per se exclusionary rule and leaves suggestive pre-charge identification procedures to due-process review, supporting a progeny/refinement role for Eyewitness Identification.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Specify that the refinement concerns Sixth Amendment counsel at identification procedures, while due-process identification limits remain available.
